subject: land docs accepts the project setup files (board/config.json, board/role-models.json, .claude/settings.json, .gitignore, the tests.* command scripts) and skips ticket files when tickets_dir is outside the repo
objective: T migration report 2026-10-27 (measured): design §2 says 'actl migrate' changes land through the project's docs channel, but land.sh:139 DOCS_PREFIXES only takes tickets/ docs/ memory/ discussions/, so the files every migration must change (board/config.json, .claude/settings.json, .gitignore, scripts/ac-tests.sh) have no sanctioned way into main. And T's tickets_dir is ../tabby_pool_ctl/tickets, not a git repo: 'actl land docs "…" tickets/<n>.json' has nothing to commit there (today it fails at git add). After this ticket: the docs channel also accepts an exact list of setup files - board/config.json, board/role-models.json, .claude/settings.json, .gitignore, and every repo-relative script file named by a tests.* command string in board/config.json (e.g. 'sh scripts/ac-tests.sh preflight' -> scripts/ac-tests.sh) - and, when tickets_dir resolves outside the code repo's work tree, a ticket path argument is skipped with one line saying the ticket pool is not versioned here.
acceptance: A1 'land.sh docs "m" board/config.json .claude/settings.json .gitignore board/role-models.json' in a throwaway repo commits all four (rc 0, one commit).

A2 with board/config.json tests.preflight = 'sh scripts/ac-tests.sh preflight', 'land.sh docs "m" scripts/ac-tests.sh' commits it; 'land.sh docs "m" scripts/other.sh' (not named by any tests.* command) is still refused rc 2 and the refusal text lists the accepted setup files.

A3 tickets_dir configured to an absolute dir outside the repo (not a git repo): 'land.sh docs "m" tickets/5.json docs/x.md' commits docs/x.md only, prints one line containing the tickets_dir path and 'not versioned', rc 0; with only 'tickets/5.json' -> that line, no commit, rc 0.
A4 existing docs-channel cases (prefix refusal, '..' / absolute path refusal, opener restricted to its own ticket file) stay green unchanged.
outline: Files: scripts/land.sh cmd_docs (~line 139-235: DOCS_PREFIXES + an exact-file list; tests.* command scripts read from board/config.json via scripts/project_config.py or event._from_config); ticket-path skip uses event.tickets_dir() vs git rev-parse --show-toplevel; opener restriction (AC_ROLE=opener -> only tickets/<AC_TICKET>.json) unchanged; usage / refusal text lists the setup files; docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md §2 row 'actl migrate' and docs/WORKFLOW.md docs-channel sentence name the setup files. Tests in tests/test_land.py next to the existing docs-channel cases.
test_plan: All contracts (A1-A4) are the worker's (needs_verifier false): tests/test_land.py next to the existing docs-channel cases, throwaway repo with a temp control root; expected strings hard-coded from this ticket.
